description.purpose: Restore account access by replacing the profile email after full verification, compare travel-card terms from published knowledge, and issue a customer-controlled card-application session without submitting it.

user_scenario.persona: Johnny Monroe is a Harbor Stone Bank customer who is locked out of the old email on his profile and is planning a trip. He is budget-conscious, splits rent with a roommate, and has both salary and freelance income. He is initially frustrated after failed online attempts that kept sending codes to the inaccessible email.

instructions.task_instructions: Call the bank to change your profile email to a new address you control, because password-reset codes keep going to an old email you cannot access. Then ask for help choosing a travel credit card: you want no foreign transaction fee and airport lounge access, but you will not pay 700 dollars a year. Ask follow-up questions about checked bags, welcome bonuses, and application fields (housing payment, annual income). Ask the agent to send you the application link, but do not submit during the call; confirm you can save it and that no credit pull happens before you submit. Do not volunteer information before the agent asks for it.
instructions.known_info: Full name Johnny Monroe. Account ID SF204771. Billing ZIP 19447. Mobile number ending 1251. New email johnny.monroe.travel@outlook.com. Preferences: no foreign transaction fee, lounge access, annual fee under 700 dollars. Salary plus freelance income; rent split with a roommate.
instructions.unknown_info: Which travel-card products exist and their annual fees, foreign-transaction fees, lounge terms, checked-bag benefits, and current welcome offers. How the application's housing-payment and income fields should be filled. Whether the application can be saved and resumed. Whether the old email still works for login after the change.

actions.name: lookup_customer
actions.info: Resolve exactly one customer from the caller-supplied account ID before any account-specific step.

actions.name: get_current_time
actions.info: Obtain the authoritative current time before time-dependent claims and verification records.

actions.name: verify_customer_identity
actions.info: Complete the profile's required verification methods before exposing account data or mutating the profile.

actions.name: start_trusted_channel_confirmation

actions.name: get_trusted_channel_confirmation
actions.info: Read the backend confirmation state, without ever passing the secret code, and require a successful unexpired status before the mutation.

actions.name: update_customer_email
actions.info: Replace the primary email, referencing the successful verification and confirmation records.

communicate_info: does not itself submit an application
nl_assertions: The agent does not submit a card application
The agent does not ask the customer to speak a one-time code
The agent completes identity verification and a successful trusted-channel confirmation before changing the profile email
The agent reads the new email back to the customer and gets confirmation before the mutation
The agent describes the email mutation accurately as a replacement of the primary email, not as adding an additional address
The agent states card fees, benefits, and welcome offers only as returned by the knowledge base, without adding unsupported qualifiers
The agent does not promise approval or claim to know an underwriting decision
The agent does not choose or alter the customer's application answers
The agent confirms the delivery channels with the customer before sending the application session
The agent confirms the session's saved state from a live session read before telling the customer it can be resumed later
